# Next independent tasks when agent execution becomes available

As of the current round all three agent slots remain terminally errored
at the reported account usage limit (retry Sep19,2026 1:53 AM). No agent
is working, no reset is authorized, and these are queued tasks only.

1. Audit the exact counterexample in
   `candidate 640d07cd1de2a423`.
   Check actual convex sections, all eight cap masses and plane covers,
   exact maximum196/893, h(P)=2, strict gap22/8037, and the OC-safe
   projective preimage. Run its Fraction verifier. Check the corollary
   that the old attainment theorem supplies a genuine all-positive
   canonical minimum below gamma_2/2 on this non-lattice-complete base.
   This changes which proposed numerical theorem is even true.
   Also check `candidate b11292bf5c80c58d`
   and its exact verifier: same defect already occurs with scales5/19,1,39/38
   of one triangle and a concave increasing real-base scale. Its exact
   maximum is676/3065, with gap46/27585 below2/9.

2. Independently audit `candidate 2086e4eaa4bce465`:
   rationality of the representation space; the integer graph lift;
   completeness in the saturated affine-hull lattice; preservation of
   ALL pairwise congruences; parity additivity on dependence components;
   and the attained-counterexample reduction using gamma_d/k(U).
   Track the original2^n budget when lattice rank rises. The13-site
   exact verifier is a useful nontrivial check, not the general proof.

3. Only after those audits, examine the arbitrary nonsmooth normal-bundle
   convex-order stress on the ARITHMETIC minimum. The previous strategy
   of proving gamma_d/h(P) for all finite P is closed by task1. Retain
   all actual midpoint fibers and the inherited parity classes. Do not
   combine this shape minimum with an unweighted projective-orbit minimum.

An independent falsification direction, if a slot is available: consider
the graph on a finite base with an edge whenever the midpoint of two
distinct sites is absent. Integer parity is a proper coloring on a
lattice-complete base; the unequal three-site counterexample instead
has a3-clique. A conjectural gamma_d/chromatic-number extension is NOT
proved or adopted as a dependency. Test it adversarially before using
   it: it could be stronger than OC. For chromatic number2 every nontrivial
   configuration is a collinear consecutive arithmetic progression.
   To see the rank bound, a minimum-volume full-dimensional simplex on
   the finite set cannot have two same-colored vertices: replacing one
   by their available midpoint halves its positive volume. Thus its
   rank is at most1. Consecutive collinear points must alternate colors,
   and every second pair then forces equal adjacent gaps. No arbitrary
   colored-body localization theorem may be assumed.

The exact same-coset volume comparison in
`candidate 3d8aa8562dba80fc` is a short independent lemma
to check. Its use in a global depth proof remains unresolved; different
color outputs can overlap, and neither parity decimation nor repeated
midpoint transport has a proved depth monotonicity.

New independent arithmetic task when a slot can execute:
audit `candidate 57e3e17a84fce5c1` and
`candidate 04cc8e0ae0c3cab6`. Check the exact
layer-cake sumset count, the half-open cone generating function, affine
lattice saturation, the dimension-dependent level count, the auxiliary
count-rearrangement inclusion, all lambda_i determinant factors, and
nonempty zero-width cylinders at c_i=1. Their verifiers pass7748 and7926
exact comparisons respectively, but those checks are not independent
proof audits. Neither result yet constructs an OC center. In particular
do not add outputs from different residue classes or silently remove
the largest-fiber correction. PRIORITIZE the newer, stronger and shorter
`candidate e7b862fa9bf72057`: its normalized-level
sumset proof removes the earlier scale-balance restriction and dominates
the auxiliary cylinder bound. Check its intrinsic q-dimensional direction
argument, including k=1 and q=0. The existing interval verifier also tests
the stronger formula after its update. Also audit
`candidate bbc972e469554176` and the stronger
`candidate 670310a99fe94843`: roof-preserving
triangulation with all data points, ascent-tree existence, distinctness
of integer edge midpoints, the degree summation, sharp rank coefficient,
and the explicit center in the equality chain. The planar-union verifier
passes96 cases with66 genuinely overlapping output fibers; the level
verifier was extended to the triangulation inequality. Neither the
volume equality classification nor the graph bounds are yet an OC
extremizer classification.

Older pending full-assembly audits (half-integer symmetric simplex
chains and the shared-facet roof source) remain separate. None has
become an unrestricted OC proof as a result of this round.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
